title: Most Probable KAM Tori in Stochastic Hamiltonian Systems Driven by Multiplicative Noise
summary: This paper investigates the effect of state-dependent multiplicative noise on the integrable structure of Hamiltonian systems. Under a local high-dimensional Lamperti-type condition, we derive the Onsager--Machlup functional in the corresponding flattening coordinates. When the diffusion vector fields are Hamiltonian, the resulting action is minimized uniquely by the deterministic Hamiltonian trajectory.
